# hetznerrobot_rdns (Resource)

Manages the PTR (reverse DNS) record for a Hetzner Robot IPv4 or IPv6 address.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The IPv4 or IPv6 address to set the PTR for. Must be an address belonging to the account.
- `ptr` (String) The PTR (hostname) to associate with the address.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
